newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-EINTRACHT FRANKFURT SACK COACH STEPANOVIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EINTRACHT FRANKFURT SACK COACH STEPANOVIC.

text.p: German second division team Eintracht Frankfurt, languishing in 14th place in the table and facing further relegation, dismissed coach Dragoslav Stepanovic after losing 3-2 to bottom club Oldenburg on Saturday.
Stepanovic joined Frankfurt, who were relegated from the Bundesliga last season, in April to replace Karl-Heinz Koerbel.
Frankfurt have only won five games out of 17 this season, drawing four and losing eight.
Rudi Bommer will take over provisionally as coach.
